Theorem
[short-time existence and uniqueness on compact manifolds] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 1.2.2\group Cao–Zhu Short-time Existence and Uniqueness For every compact Riemannian manifold $(M,g_0)$, there is $T>0$ and a unique smooth solution of $\partial _tg=-2\Ric (g)$ on $M\times [0,T)$ with $g(0)=g_0$.
Proof

\sketch Solve the strictly parabolic DeTurck flow \cite{Ha82, De}. The associated harmonic-map heat flow supplies diffeomorphisms recovering Ricci flow. Applying the same construction to two Ricci flows reduces uniqueness to parabolic uniqueness and then to uniqueness of the diffeomorphism ODE.

□
